verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only UI-driven exports: Excel reports and an Open Cap Table Format (OCF) file export. There is no documented programmatic API for pulling stakeholders, share classes, securities or vesting states, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. A manual OCF file export is an adjacent feature, not a programmatic API, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full capitalization table — stakeholders, share classes, securities, and vesting states — through a documented programmatic API
